name: Tale of Two
source:
You take the role of Ash and Mila, our two lovebirds. Recently engaged and looking forward to their big day.

Take control as they navigate their day to day lives while encountering a colorful cast of characters.

Will they get their happily ever after? Or will it blow up in their faces?
What sort of shenanigans will they get up to?
Their future is in your hands.​

[From F95Zone]
